crossRefs.note: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

parallels.note: There are also workmen with you in abundance, cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are…

translations.web: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
translations.bsb: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
translations.kjv: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
translations.asv: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of workmanship.
